title: 2017 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Fire Rooster
seo_title: 2017 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Fire Rooster (28 January – 15 February 2018)
description: 2017 is the Year of the Fire Rooster (Yin, Ding-you), from 28 January 2017 to 15 February 2018. Personality, lucky colors and numbers, best matches, and what to know if you were born in January or February 2017.
lead: Born in 2017? Your Chinese zodiac animal is most likely the Rooster, but check the date: the 2017 Fire Rooster year began on 28 January 2017. Here is everything about the year, from its element to its lucky colors and best matches.
card_text: 2017: Year of the Fire Rooster, from 28 January 2017 to 15 February 2018.

paras: The Chinese zodiac year 2017 was the Year of the Rooster. It began with Lunar New Year on 28 January 2017 and ended on 15 February 2018, the eve of the next Lunar New Year.

Each year also has an element and a Yin or Yang quality. 2017 ends in 7, which makes it a Fire year, and as an odd year it is Yin. In the traditional stem-and-branch count, 2017 is a Ding-you year. The same Fire Rooster combination comes round only once every 60 years: 1957 before it and 2077 after it.
Lunar New Year 2017 fell on 28 January 2017. Anyone born from 1 January 2017 up to the day before belongs to the previous year's animal, the Monkey; from 28 January 2017 on, the Rooster.

The zodiac year starts at Lunar New Year, not on 1 January, which is why early-year birthdays need checking. Our guide Born in January? explains the rule, and the zodiac sign checker gives the exact answer for any birth date.

Our Rooster guide describes the sign like this: “Observant, hard-working, and confident. Roosters are detail-oriented and take pride in doing things well.” The usual watch-out: “Can be overly critical or blunt with others.”

The Fire element adds its own flavour. Fire years bring passion, energy, and boldness. People of this element tend to be dynamic, adventurous, and quick to lead. Read more in our Fire element guide, or the full Year of the Rooster page.
Careers often linked with the Rooster: accounting, journalism, quality control, public speaking.

sections.h2: Best matches for someone born in 2017
paras: In traditional compatibility, the Rooster's best matches are the Ox, Snake and Dragon, and its clash sign is the Rabbit, which sits directly opposite it on the zodiac circle. Our compatibility calculator compares two full birth dates, elements included.
2026 (Fire Horse, until 5 February 2027): for the Rooster, it has no special traditional relationship with the Horse, so 2026 is a neutral year.
2027 (Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027): for the Rooster, it has no special traditional relationship with the Goat, so 2027 is a neutral year. See Chinese zodiac 2027 predictions for every sign.

sections.h2: Other Year of the Rooster years
paras: Years of the same animal come every twelve years, each with a different element: 1993 (Water Rooster); 2005 (Wood Rooster); 2029 (Earth Rooster). The full list is in our Chinese zodiac years chart.

faq: 2017 is the Year of the Rooster, a Yin Fire Rooster year (Ding-you).
When does the 2017 Year of the Rooster start and end?
It starts on 28 January 2017 and ends on 15 February 2018.
I was born in January 2017. What is my Chinese zodiac?
If you were born before 28 January 2017, you are a Monkey; from 28 January 2017 on, a Rooster.
Fire. 2017 ends in 7, which belongs to Fire, and it is a Yin year.
Who is the Rooster compatible with?
Traditionally the Ox, Snake and Dragon. The Rooster's clash sign is the Rabbit.
